node.title: Re^4: running a backticks command behaves different in command line and browser
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
look into IPC::Open3 and possibly IO::Pty

IMHO those are relatively low-level. Personally, I'd recommend [mod://IPC::Run], as it supports interactive communication with the subprocesses it runs and can be used in an [mod://Expect]-like manner, plus a few other advanced features. I showed one example in the [id://1180578|node I linked to].
